Made with Natural Earth. https://www.naturalearthdata.com/

Natural Earth boundary data are public domain.
Source terms https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

world_paths.csv contains prepared SVG paths derived from 1:110m present-day
country boundaries, excluding Antarctica. world_sf.geojson contains the
corresponding sf-ready polygons. Boundary preparation and explicit geometry
repairs are recorded in world_sf_metadata.json.

europe_sf.geojson uses 1:50m present-day boundaries. Its source, regional extent
and preparation are recorded in eu_metadata.json.

Coordinates in aid_nodes.csv are approximate display locations, not aid
project locations. All amounts in aid.csv and the fictional aid connections
are teaching data, not observed aid flows.
